Initial release of Git Blame Archaeologist — a tool that uncovers the "why" behind any code using only local git history.

- Chains `git blame`, `git log --follow`, and commit messages to reconstruct decision rationale for any file, line, or block.
- Detects and traces file renames/moves, ensuring full history through extensive refactors.
- Flags "mystery blocks" — unexplained code, terse commit messages, and commits with poor context.
- Works 100% offline using only the local git binary, no external APIs required.
- Supports rich trigger phrases and command-line usage patterns for a variety of git archaeology tasks.
